editorial:
Imagine you are just hanging out in your dorm with your best friend on a Friday night. Everything feels normal until you realize a killer in a Ghostface mask is stalking you. You get to follow two college roommates who think they are safe in their own space, but the vibe shifts fast from a chill evening to a total fight for survival. It feels like those classic slashers where you are screaming at the screen for the characters to just run out the door. The tension builds up quickly, and you really feel the panic as one girl tries everything she can to keep her friend alive while the killer plays mind games with them.

What really works here is how fast the movie moves. The acting feels real, and the scares hit hard without being too over the top. While some of the plot points are a bit predictable, the action keeps you on the edge of your seat. If you love a good cat-and-mouse game, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the dark details, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big fan of the genre, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out that the killer was actually a classmate who felt betrayed by the girls. In a final showdown, the roommate uses her surroundings to trap Ghostface, eventually stabbing him in the leg to escape. She manages to save her friend just as the police arrive. The movie wraps up with a chilling shot showing that another mask is still hidden, hinting that the nightmare might not be over for everyone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic slasher movies and high-tension survival stories.
